design_status: Committed locally before generating fresh test data; targeted follow-up on already inspected sequence/reader failures.

permutation.statistic: Two-sided adjacent-repeat deviation conditional on the tool multiset: abs(n * observed_equal_adjacent_pairs - sum_tool count*(count-1)). Integer arithmetic avoids numerical tie ambiguity.
permutation.null: Independently uniformly permute the canonical tool multiset within each session. Preserve tool counts, session length, timestamps/outcomes/identities; shuffle only tool assignments for the null statistic.
permutation.rng: Per-multiset SHA-256 seed of master seed plus sorted tool/count pairs; excludes observed order, labels, population, tenant/actor/session IDs and processing order.
permutation.score: replicates minus count(null_statistic >= observed_statistic); larger is more anomalous. Diagnostic Monte Carlo p=(1+exceedances)/(replicates+1), not a malicious-activity probability.
permutation.threshold: Unlabelled validation q98 of integer scores, strict greater-than. No training fit and no population-specific calibration for this new baseline.

tie_policy.method: For every detector in this new comparison, pre-order sessions by SHA-256 of seed plus tenant/actor/session key, then use stable descending-score top-k. Report boundary ties. Identity affects only fixed tie priority, never score or null RNG.

mixture: Retain every session in each independent generator stream with the unchanged generator/make_batch helper. No label-based sampling.
primary: Permutation baseline reader-sequence recovery, precision/recall and false alerts versus existing detectors on fresh_permutation_joint under one global cap of 24 unique sessions.
secondary: reader misses below threshold versus cap/tie suppression
sampled-null degeneracy and finite Monte Carlo resolution
gains/losses and paired actor-cluster recall differences
promotion_policy: Report all predeclared cohorts and comparators, keep historical evidence and reference unchanged, and do not retune statistic/replicates/threshold/seed after seeing fresh results.
limitations: Conditional exchangeability of tool order is plausible for this IID benign synthetic generator, but legitimate real workflows have structured order and may alert.
The repeated-run statistic is targeted to previously inspected ordering failures; fresh instances are not blind family validation.
Conditioning on counts deliberately removes volume, denial, frequency and composition signals; constant-tool or weakly informative sessions may remain undetectable.
499 null draws give p resolution 1/500 and a saturated integer score; ties and the shared budget can exclude real anomalies.
Diagnostic Monte Carlo p values are conditional randomization evidence, not attack probabilities or real-world false-positive guarantees.
All detectors share the same label-free tie policy in this study; tie priorities differ from earlier studies, which remain untouched.
Paired bootstrap intervals condition on fitted models, fixed null draws and fixed alert decisions; they omit calibration, Monte Carlo and reranking uncertainty.
